name: MTP x Network (gate, core_8)
description: Signal-level combination: MTP cycle exposure multiplied by (0.5 + 0.5 x network agreement) — network disagreement halves exposure. Combines Garg-Goulding-Harvey-Mazzoleni (JFE 2023) with Li-Ferreira (arXiv 2501.07135) at signal level rather than portfolio level.
